provenance.sampling_update.note: New runs use temperature 0.8 and nucleus threshold top_p 0.9 for both stages and all cohorts. The 640-new-token ceilings, model revision, prompt text, seed, quantization, child pairs and story assignments are unchanged by this update. This records an author-adopted setting, not a claim of task-specific empirical validation. The inherited top-k behavior is unchanged; an explicit top-k decision remains pending.

output_ceiling.note: New runs allow up to 640 new tokens per stage for every cohort, with 72 tokens above the longest saved real story at ages four through seven under all four checked tokenizers, including the pinned official Llama tokenizer. The budget excludes input tokens; earlier end-of-sequence stopping remains in effect. This is an operational ceiling, not a requested narrative length or a guarantee that generated outputs cannot reach it. Prompt wording and all other generation settings are unchanged.

model_source_correction.note: The previous publisher describes a community conversion of Llama 3.2 11B Vision with its vision components removed. New runs use Meta's official Llama 3.1 8B Instruct checkpoint, pinned to the revision checked on 20 October 2026. This is a model change; it does not relabel or reconstruct the historical generator. Decoding settings, prompt templates and experimental assignments are unchanged by this correction. Comparative and vision conditions remain proposals pending protocol review.

counterbalancing.note: Two reversed exemplar assignments per target, always from the opposite story set. At ten replicates, the existing alternating scheduler uses each assignment five times per prompt pair and target. This balances exemplar roles and overall complexity levels; other revised-study decisions remain pending. The previous configuration is preserved in the verified study freeze.

shared_generation_protocol.note: The author confirmed that age four used the same generation configuration as ages five through seven. The portable notebook applies these shared settings to every cohort.
